description:
Certified electrician Joe Felz & inventor Julian Brown walk you through how to install solar batteries on this 100 kWh mobile install, which will be used to power Julian's pyrolysis machine. The system here will achieve 100 KW of continuous 230V output with spikes up to 131 A and provide 200 KW of solar energy when maximized at 112 panels, but all components fit in one custom trailer. The Ethos system is UL compliant with full grid tie & backup power function and is Joe's choice for REAL LIFE solar systems.
